But when installing from existing config, the config importer installs modules in an order and installs openculturas_openstreetmap before geocoder. The root problem is config/sync/core.extension.yml lists openculturas_openstreetmap but geocoder is listed earlier in core.extension... Wait, geocoder at line 66 and openculturas_openstreetmap at line 119. But install order is determined by dependency graph (sort), not alphabetical.

The error: installing openculturas_openstreetmap triggers kernel boot which needs geocoder.throttle, but geocoder hasn't been installed yet at that point. Because openculturas_openstreetmap doesn't declare dependency on geocoder, the graph may install it before geocoder.
